confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Yogyakarta price levels, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and café anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by area and season. Beer, cocktail and wine are less certain because alcohol is scarcer in ordinary local venues and carries high taxes. The FX value comes from the RBA exchange-rates page as shown in search results; I did not open the page or its F11 table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on the regional price level of Yogyakarta as a mid-sized Indonesian backpacker and cultural tourism city, cross-checked against other Southeast Asian tourist cities with similar budget and mid-range costs.
